title: Ameesha Patel breaks silence on parents’ Churchgate home robbery- Exclusive
description: Ameesha and Ashmit Patel’s parents have reportedly fallen victim to an alleged jewellery theft at their Churchgate residence, with valuables worth approximately Rs 5 lakh missing. While Ashmit details the circumstances surrounding the alleged theft, Ameesha says she is relieved that her family is safe.

title: Where to watch 'Girlfriends': Sitcom exits Netflix after Sept 11
description: Fans of the iconic sitcom Girlfriends will be disappointed to learn that it has left Netflix's streaming platform. However, there’s good news: all eight seasons are now available for free on Pluto TV. For more viewing options, episodes can be streamed on Dabl, accessible through Hulu and YouTube TV, or bought individually via Amazon Prime Video.

title: 'Haiwaan' Day 3 (LIVE): Akshay starrer struggling to cross Rs 10 cr
description: Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, earned Rs 5.96 crore net. The film collected Rs 3 crore on its debut day and Rs 2.50 crore on day two. On its third day, the Priyadarshan-helmed movie garnered Rs 0.46 crore. It is currently competing with Mirzapur: The Movie and Hanuman Ansh. The movie is a remake of the Malayalam film Oppam.

title: Tech company seeks lawsuit dismissal: firm urges US court to toss Dua Lipa case
description: In a recent legal battle, a major tech company has petitioned a court to dismiss Dua Lipa's case over image rights. They contend that the pop star does not possess the trademark rights needed to initiate this lawsuit, asserting that the images were used within an interface, not as an endorsement. The company also points fingers at a content provider for obtaining the required permissions.

title: 'Mirzapur' BO Day 9 (LIVE): Pankaj Tripathi's film to cross Rs 180 cr

On the tenth day, the film gathered two point two crore rupees, competing fiercely with other current releases. The overall net collection across India has now reached one hundred seventy three point sixty five crore rupees, showcasing its popularity among audiences.

title: Sonali Kulkarni on actresses being typecast as mothers
description: Sonali Kulkarni, who played Salman Khan's mother in 'Bharat' despite being younger than him, says actresses aren't sidelined post-marriage anymore. She praised Saif Ali Khan and Aamir Khan for embracing versatile, age-defying roles, citing Aamir's transformation in 'Dangal' as proof that talented actors today don't fear looking their age.

title: 'Hanuman Ansh' BO Day 38 (LIVE): Film eyes Rs 210 cr in India
description: Despite facing competition from other films, Hanuman Ansh has shown remarkable resilience at the box office, achieving impressive profitability. title: Travis Kelce talks about marrying Taylor Swift
description: Travis Kelce expressed his overwhelming happiness about marrying Taylor Swift in a recent interview. He called their wedding night the highlight of his life, highlighting the warmth and connection felt by all the guests present. Kelce appreciated how seamlessly both families blended together during the celebration, which took place on July 3 at the iconic Madison Square Garden.

title: Veteran star Mithun Chakraborty bought this sprawling Madh Island bungalow In 1985

The family later returned to live there full-time after using it as a holiday home. Separate cottages provide individual spaces for family members and house a dedicated film office. The residence also features an in-house studio and preserves his career legacy.

title: When Akshay Kumar went to Rajesh Khanna's office seeking work

title: Quote Of the day by Bruce Lee
description: Bruce Lee's teachings illuminate a journey toward self-awareness and genuineness. His philosophy advocates for individuals to shed imitation and embrace their authentic selves, a message that resonates strongly even in today's age of social media comparisons. Starting his acting career young and delving into philosophy during his time in Seattle, Bruce Lee Day is now celebrated in California to recognize his lasting cultural impact.
